answer: Each agent must lock a refundable capital bond before it may trade or vote, and influence is weighted by that staked capital, not by headcount. An honest agent posts one bond, hard and lasting as cedar; a sybil operator forging a thousand masks must lock a thousand separate bonds, since one small walnut of capital cannot be split to cover them all. Random audits slash the whole stake on proven fraud, so a fake cluster trying to climb like a vine up the trust lattice is pruned the moment it cheats, and attacker cost scales linearly per clone.
